listing.name: Vampire Savior2: The Lord of Vampire (CPS-2 Recomp)
listing.summary: Play Vampire Savior2: The Lord of Vampire using your own matching arcade originals.

restrictions.explanation: This CPS-2 Recomp test build needs an existing copy. Choose a full collection release for a new setup.

steps.title: Use the exact original arcade set
steps.instruction: Use your own exact arcade ROM set vsav2 (Japan 970913), including its game key file, from a board you own. Another region or revision does not substitute for it. Keep originals separate and unchanged. The launcher accepts the set ZIP or its files folder and checks the files by checksum; when shared files are split, keep the matching parent ZIP beside it. Portcove registration does not authenticate the set or supply copyrighted game files.

steps.title: Prepare the shared launcher and this game
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official Preview package for your system: CPS2Recomp-windows-x64.zip, CPS2Recomp-linux-x86_64.tar.gz, or the universal CPS2Recomp-macOS.zip with CPS-2 Recomp.app. Keep cps2recomp-launcher (cps2recomp-launcher.exe on Windows), every game program and all packaged companions together. Run the upstream launcher deliberately, choose your ROM folder or this game’s exact set, then finish its settings before registering the player. Register the launcher for your system with the CPS2Recomp folder as working directory: cps2recomp-launcher.exe on Windows or cps2recomp-launcher on Linux. On macOS, register CPS-2 Recomp.app/Contents/MacOS/cps2recomp-launcher with Contents/MacOS as working directory. Enter two literal argument lines: --play then vsav2. The launcher owns this game’s configuration and child programs; do not register a source archive, update manifest or arbitrary other game executable.

steps.title: Add the game and manage updates
steps.instruction: The project’s shared launcher checks for updates and can replace the collection after its games close. Before using its update controls, keep a copy of the working game files and profile. Add this external copy to Portcove, then choose Play separately when you are ready. Removing its registration leaves the package, originals and profiles in place. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, data migration or deletion for these files.

warnings: This is beta software. The project reports fighting-game and scripted checks; Portcove has not confirmed gameplay or saving from those reports.
Close all games and launchers before copying settings, save states, board memory, custom colours, scores, soundtrack files and logs.

The launcher offers the initial copy to portable mode; Portcove does not move that data. Removing portable.txt changes where future sessions store data without moving existing files. Keep both locations and the working game version until the replacement works. Save-state compatibility and importing existing data have not been confirmed.

references.title: Preserve the actual game and launcher data
references.instruction: Use the launcher’s Your files / Show controls to find its folder and each game’s data folder. Windows normally stores game data under %APPDATA%/<Game>/. A portable.txt file beside the launcher selects CPS2Recomp/user/, with separate launcher and game subfolders. Close all games and launchers before copying settings, save states, board memory, custom colours, scores, soundtrack files and logs. The launcher offers the initial copy to portable mode; Portcove does not move that data. Removing portable.txt changes where future sessions store data without moving existing files. Keep both locations and the working game version until the replacement works. Save-state compatibility and importing existing data have not been confirmed.

references.title: Linux ARM64 and Android
references.instruction: For Linux ARM64, use CPS2Recomp-linux-arm64.tar.gz and run cps2recomp-launcher. On an ARM64 device running Android 9 or later, install CPS2Recomp-android.apk and use Games → Add ROM sets. Get both packages and their checksums from the upstream release page.
